Weekly revenue

## Revenue by region

| Region | Revenue |
| --- | ---: |
| West | 1,204,000 |
| East | 988,500 |

- West led for the third week
- East recovered

```sql
SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY 1
```
